body.text: Confirmed! 1. Exact function signature: greet(name: str) -> str in greet.py. 2. Returns 'Hello, NAME!' for normal name (e.g. greet('Alice') -> 'Hello, Alice!'). 3. Surrounding whitespace is stripped before formatting (e.g. greet('  Alice ') -> 'Hello, Alice!'). 4. Raises ValueError for empty or whitespace-only names.
